T: Open the juke joint. Close the doors.
D: Twin brothers come home to 1930s Mississippi to open a juke joint, and something comes knocking.
P: Serve the mains when the juke joint opens for the night.
S: Fine cornmeal and flour mixed with buttermilk, egg, grated onion and a pinch of sugar, rested 10 minutes, spooned into 175C oil and fried golden. Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, a pinch of sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk and rest 10 minutes. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce to dip.
a taste of the Mississippi Delta

Catfish strips soaked in buttermilk and hot sauce, crusted in seasoned cornmeal and fried crisp, with a Cajun remoulade and lemon. Cut 500g catfish or flathead fillets into strips and soak in 250ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce for 30 minutes. Mix 150g fine cornmeal, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp each salt, paprika and garlic powder and half a tsp cayenne. Dredge the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp Dijon, chopped gherkins, capers, paprika and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.
Thick white bread spread with roast garlic butter and toasted
Thick slices of white bread spread with butter mashed with a whole head of roasted garlic, parsley and salt, toasted at 200C until crisp at the edges.
M: Delta red beans and rice with sausage
feeding the crowd on the juke joint's opening night

Red kidney beans simmered slow with smoked sausage, ham hock, capsicum, celery and Cajun spice, ladled over fluffy white rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Brown 400g sliced smoked sausage in a large pot. Add 1 onion, 1 green capsicum and 2 celery sticks, diced, and 3 garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Add 2 tsp Cajun seasoning, 2 x 400g tins drained kidney beans, 1 small smoked ham hock and 1L chicken stock. Simmer 75 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken. Shred the ham back in. Serve over 300g cooked long grain rice with spring onion and hot sauce.
Browned pork chops simmered in an onion roux gravy

Thick pork chops seasoned, floured and browned, then simmered 40 minutes in an onion gravy made from a dark roux, chicken stock and thyme. Season, flour and brown 4 thick pork chops. Make a dark roux with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions, then 500ml stock and thyme. Simmer the chops in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g long grain rice.
W: Mashed roasted sweet potato pie with brown sugar, nutmeg and vanilla
Roasted sweet potato mashed smooth with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: Irish stout poured slowly in two stages for a tight head

Dark Irish stout poured in two stages for a thick creamy head. Tilt each glass and pour the stout three-quarters full, let it settle for a minute, then top up slowly for a tight head. Allow 2 cans or bottles per person.

s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, a pinch of sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk and rest 10 minutes. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce to dip.

s.note: Thick white bread spread with roast garlic butter and toasted
s.how: Roast a head of garlic in foil at 180C for 40 minutes. Squeeze into 100g soft butter with parsley and salt and mash. Spread on 8 thick slices of white bread and toast at 200C until crisp at the edges.

m.note: Browned pork chops simmered in an onion roux gravy
m.how: Season, flour and brown 4 thick pork chops. Make a dark roux with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions, then 500ml stock and thyme. Simmer the chops in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g long grain rice.

w.note: Mashed roasted sweet potato pie with brown sugar, nutmeg and vanilla
w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, peel and mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes.

d.note: Irish stout poured slowly in two stages for a tight head
